title: CV Tutorial chapters 11–15 — claim/source register
scope: Primary papers and official APIs; figures and runnable samples are illustrative, not benchmarks.

entries.claim: ViT splits images into patches, embeds and positions tokens, runs pre-LN transformer encoder with class token
entries.caveat: 197 tokens refers specifically to 224x224, patch16 and one CLS; large-scale pretraining shapes results

entries.claim: Attention softmax is applied along key axis to QK^T/sqrt(dk), then weighted sum with V
entries.caveat: MathML expresses single-head attention and omits position embedding/multihead output projection

entries.claim: ConvNeXt-T uses depths 3,3,9,3 and dims 96,192,384,768 with 7x7 depthwise convolution
entries.caveat: V2 introduced other blocks, and original block may include gamma and stochastic-depth components

entries.claim: For same 96 in/out channels, standard 7x7 has 451584 spatial kernel weights vs depthwise 4704
entries.caveat: Only compares DW spatial convolution parameter count, excluding pointwise channel mixing and bias

entries.claim: AdamW decouples weight decay from adaptive gradient update
entries.caveat: Toy zero-gradient parameter demonstrates decay with grad tensor present, not model convergence

entries.claim: Mixed precision, schedule, reproducibility depend on optimizer steps, precision and runtime
entries.caveat: Warmup+cosine curve is a made-up policy, not a trained model result

entries.claim: FLOPs/MACs/parameters and measured latency differ in definitions
entries.caveat: Pareto points are synthetic, not paper results

entries.claim: Calibration and Expected Calibration Error depend on confidence, binning and predicted outcome
entries.caveat: Toy confidence bins illustrate overconfidence, not a calibrated model experiment

entries.claim: COCO primary detection AP averages IoU thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95 and includes small medium large object metrics
entries.caveat: AP is not a single-score precision value; matching and recall interpolation depend on benchmark protocol

entries.claim: Batched NMS filters within classes and IoU of half-open continuous boxes has area difference
entries.caveat: Toy NMS is deterministic on distinct scores, does not implement Soft-NMS nor all COCO ignore rules

entries.claim: DETR is set prediction with bipartite matching, not classic dense NMS procedure
entries.caveat: Some derived detectors have other architecture and postprocessing
